title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Volume Price Break
content:
## Basis

The volume price break on the monthly fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the billed seats for the break, which are the covered seats on the seat ledger (every seat addition less every seat removal) or the minimum-commitment floor, whichever is greater. The floor is the contracted seats multiplied by the tier's minimum seat commitment percentage and divided by 100, rounded up to a whole seat.

## The break

The break is graduated:
- each billed seat from the 40th up to the 74th earns 2.0 percent off;
- each billed seat from the 75th up earns 4.0 percent off;
- the earned percentages are summed and divided by the billed seats to give the percentage taken off the monthly fee;
- with fewer than 40 billed seats nothing is taken off.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Billed seats for the break | Seats at 2.0 | Seats at 4.0 | Percentage taken off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 39 | none | none | nothing |
| 40 | 1 (the 40th) | none | 2.0 divided by 40, that is 0.05 percent |
| 60 | 21 (40th to 60th) | none | 42 divided by 60, that is 0.7 percent |
| 74 | 35 | none | 70 divided by 74, about 0.946 percent |
| 75 | 35 | 1 | 74 divided by 75, about 0.987 percent |
| 100 | 35 | 26 | 70 plus 104, that is 174, divided by 100, that is 1.74 percent |

When the ledger shows 30 covered seats but the floor is 45, the break reads 45 billed seats and takes 12 divided by 45 percent off, about 0.267 percent.
